files.name: motion-prompt-126.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Motion path" (モーションパス), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves, part 2".
Motion Prompt #126

What it is: Moves along a curve that you define
What the sample shows: A paper plane follows a dotted path, turning as it goes and looping the loop on the way.
Spec:
- One pass per 4.7 s, from off-screen left to off-screen right. The path is x = 270 + 112θ − 150·sinθ, y = 106 − 74·cosθ for θ = −π→π, which makes a loop at the top centre.
- θ advances in proportion to time (so the speed along the path is not constant; the loop looks slower).
- The plane turns to the path direction: angle = atan2(74·sinθ, 112 − 150·cosθ).
- The path is shown in advance as a dotted line (width 6, dash 2/15). A mint trail of 24 segments (0.03 in θ each) follows, thinner and fainter towards the back.
When to use it: Use it whenever something should follow a set route: a flying object, a car, a journey on a map.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/126.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion2.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
